blockers.description: Plugin window sizing in Ardour: editor requests 900x1100 but host gives ~450x350. Tried: (1) setResizable(false,false) — original, Ardour clips. (2) resized() guard forcing setSize — fought host, worse. (3) 900x700 — squashed, still mispositioned. (4) setResizable(true,false)+constrainer — still small. Screen is 1920x1080. Anthony says room exists. Likely a JUCE-Ardour size negotiation issue or stale Ardour scan cache from the VST3 crash (scan-result=2).
